description.p: Calculator is a native desktop calculator with Standard, Scientific and Programmer modes over a shared portable calculation core.
The Linux desktop application uses GTK4 and integrates with the system application menu, icon theme and Software Manager through AppStream.
Correct Financial precision and range handling, bound depreciation calculations, and preserve coherent results when importing variables, functions or settings.
Correct Scientific result and precision retention, numerical range and root checks, signed radix output and shared GUI/CLI saves. Require tested native LTO and trained PGO installation.
Fix same-version native package reinstall handling and reject older source releases before compiling or installing.
Improve compact GTK control contrast and readability using the extended MB Corpo typography and Common semantic roles.
Align the Windows and iPhone interfaces with the verified extended MB Corpo typography for readable text, compact controls and separate Screen2 calculation results.
Qualify standalone Linux installation of the 23-face shared MB Corpo typography catalogue via pinned Common 1.19.57, without duplicating font payloads in the Calculator package.
Improve Linux Calculator typography with new MB Corpo Text and compact controls plus a Screen2 numerical readout when InfiltratorOS's extended font cache is available.
Use the persistent native /System/Resources/Fonts cache on Linux through the verified Libraries 1.19.51 bootstrap while keeping Windows font embedding private.
Publish the post-0.2.48 native filesystem implementation with Calculator exclusively under /Programs and all standalone/native installation paths aligned to that contract.
